title: Classify these five reports
prompt: Place each customer report in the correct failure category.

pairs.item: The agent answered, but ignored the format we specified and picked a tool we did not ask for.
pairs.why: Wrong tools planned and ignored instructions are instruction-following failures.

pairs.item: It says the policy document cannot be found, but the document is definitely indexed.
pairs.why: Right tool, wrong or missing results, including not found when it exists.

pairs.item: The ticket was half created and then the step returned a timeout.
pairs.why: Partial writes and timeouts are action and integration failures.

pairs.item: It was supposed to run at 6am on new documents and it has not run at all.
pairs.why: Never runs, runs at the wrong time, or runs on the wrong content.

pairs.item: The save button does nothing when the admin edits the agent.
pairs.why: Save failures and permissions problems are UI and configuration issues.

takeaway: Classification is the fastest debugging skill to build and the one that saves the most time.
